provider_patterns.notes: 302 to the current stream-server snapshot.jpg with Last-Modified; returns 404 when the camera is offline (e.g. alias 603f630e33844, Chelan Realty). Alias is in any ipcamlive embed/player URL.
302 to newest timestamped frame on assetsNN.webcam.io, Last-Modified present. ID is in the embed iframe https://webcam.io/webcams/<ID>?embed=true. /api/webcams/<ID>/latest.jpg is 404.

/default 302s to the latest ~5600x800 panorama (verified on two JHMR cams via seejh.ai). For a livecam page with no known CAMID, structure.json in the page folder is public JSON (no key) listing the latest frames: thumbnail 1350x150, centerprev 630x450, quarter 4608x512, half, full. Many western resorts/hotels use Roundshot.

1280x720 thumbnail refreshed while the stream is live (md5 changed within 10 min); Cache-Control max-age=300, no Last-Modified. When a stream ends the file freezes (Mt Baker cam still serves a July frame), so the hourly job should confirm "isLiveNow":true on https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=<ID> and drop or flag otherwise. IDs change when an owner restarts a stream.
Public share of the last uploaded frame, Last-Modified present; optional &width=&height= resizes. IDs come from the owner's public embed.
